summary: The skills suite has strong guardrails and a clear workflow structure, but contains a gate-feeding deadlock between pg-upgrade-precheck and tracker-check.mjs, an unguarded default codex backend in run-review-round.sh, and bypasses in Approver validation and the shell/MCP guardrail hooks. Fixing the tracker gate linkages, hook patterns, approval rules, and missing source entries in reference/sources.md is required before relying on these skills in production upgrades.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-precheck assigns Finding rows to gates G0.3 and G0.4, which deadlocks Block 0 whenever any blocker or prework item is discovered, or forces findings to be marked Done before Block 1 fixes them. Under pg-upgrade-gate-review and tracker-lib.mjs, a gate cannot close while any row listing it in Gates is open, even though findings are only fixed in production and closed in Block 1 under G1.1.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-precheck/SKILL.md line 40 states: "Findings: one Finding row per blocker and per prework item, with an ID like F-6g-01, and Owner set to the DBA or unknown. Errors and warnings from the provider precheck feed G0.3. Everything from the kit (sections 2 to 8) feeds G0.4". However, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-gate-review/SKILL.md lines 14-18 require every feeding row to be "Done with Evidence" or "Waived", and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/scripts/tracker-lib.mjs lines 118-124 emit an error ("gate is ${gate.Status} but ${open.map((r) => r.ID).join(", ")} still open") if a gate closes while any feeding row is open, whereas review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/assets/tracker.csv line 21 (G1.1) and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/sop.md line 114 state that original Finding rows are closed in Block 1 ("each original Finding row closed with its own evidence").
findings.suggested_fix: Have Finding rows created in pg-upgrade-precheck feed G1.1 (where fixes are verified in production and findings close), while G0.3 and G0.4 check that B0-03/B0-04/B0-05 are Done and every Finding row has an Owner and a Block 1 fix task.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-model-review states that approvedReviewBackends defaults to ["subagent"] and restricts external model providers when compliance covers regulated data, but run-review-round.sh defaults REVIEWERS to include codex:gpt-6-astra and never checks upgrade/project.json. Invoking run-review-round.sh without REVIEWERS set (or when reviewers is omitted from project.json) sends upgrade artifacts to OpenAI and Cursor CLI backends without approval.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-model-review/SKILL.md lines 16-18 state: "codex: <plugin>/scripts/review-with-codex.sh, which needs the Codex CLI installed and signed in. It sends files to OpenAI. Use only the backends listed in approvedReviewBackends. If it's missing, use subagent only." Yet review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/scripts/run-review-round.sh line 18 sets reviewers="${REVIEWERS:-codex:gpt-6-astra cursor:gemini-4-argon-high cursor:grok-4.7-high cursor:claude-opus-5-5-high}" and runs review-with-codex.sh without checking upgrade/project.json.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the default codex:gpt-6-astra fallback in run-review-round.sh and have the script validate each requested reviewer backend against approvedReviewBackends in upgrade/project.json when present.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-catch-up instructs setting Approver to "unknown" when a decider is not named, but tracker-lib.mjs only checks !row.Approver (empty string) when validating closed Gate, Decision, and Waived rows. Consequently, a Gate, Decision, or Waived row with Approver set to "unknown" passes tracker-check.mjs without a real named approver.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-catch-up/SKILL.md line 17 instructs: "Add a Decision row, with Approver set to the named decider (or unknown) and Status set to Needs approval." In review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/scripts/tracker-lib.mjs lines 95-99, validation only checks "if (row.Status === \"Waived\" && !row.Approver)", "if (row.Type === \"Gate\" && row.Status === \"Done\" && !row.Approver)", and "if (row.Type === \"Decision\" && CLOSED.has(row.Status) && !row.Approver)", all of which pass when row.Approver is the non-empty string "unknown".
findings.suggested_fix: Update tracker-lib.mjs lines 95-99 to reject Approver values equal to "unknown" (case-insensitive) whenever a row is Waived or a Gate or Decision row is closed.

findings.claim: The shell guardrail hook's regexes require the subcommand to immediately follow the CLI binary (such as gcloud sql, aws rds, terraform apply, gh pr merge, or git push), so placing any global flag after the binary name (for example gcloud --project=prod sql instances patch or terraform -chdir=infra apply) bypasses the hook. In addition, read-only provider commands such as gcloud sql instances describe are not blocked despite the guardrails rule forbidding agents from running any provider commands.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/hooks/block-prod-db.mjs lines 91-117 match prog at index === 0 against /\bgcloud\s+(?:beta\s+|alpha\s+)?sql\s+.../, /\baws\s+rds\s+.../, /\b(?:terraform|tofu|terragrunt)\s+(?:apply|destroy|import)\b/, /\bgh\s+pr\s+merge\b/, and /\bgit\s+push\b/, none of which match when global flags appear before the subcommand. Meanwhile, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/rules/guardrails.mdc line 11 states: "Write the commands, such as precheck queries, gcloud, vacuumdb or the runbook steps, for a person to run. Don't run them yourself, even read-only. The project's hooks block the common forms of these commands".
findings.suggested_fix: Update RULES in hooks/block-prod-db.mjs to allow arbitrary flags and option arguments between the binary and subcommand, and block all gcloud sql, gcloud alloydb, aws rds, and az postgres subcommands including describe/list/show.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-model-review defaults to the subagent backend and requires at least two successful reviewers from different model families, but agents/independent-reviewer.md hardcodes model: inherit and the skill only documents model selection via cursor-agent --list-models for the cursor CLI backend. Following the default subagent path runs every subagent on the parent session's inherited model family, causing step 3 to mark the review incomplete and stop.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-model-review/SKILL.md lines 14-18 state "subagent (the default): read-only subagents in this Cursor session... If it's missing, use subagent only", and line 35 states: "A round needs at least two successful reviewers from different model families. Below that, mark the review incomplete, tell the gate owner the gate can't rely on it, and stop." Meanwhile, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/agents/independent-reviewer.md line 4 sets "model: inherit", and pg-upgrade-model-review/SKILL.md lines 22 and 30-34 only show cursor: CLI reviewer strings without specifying how to override subagent models across families.
findings.suggested_fix: Specify in pg-upgrade-model-review/SKILL.md how to pass distinct model slugs from different model families when spawning subagents (instead of relying on model: inherit) and how subagent reviewers are formatted in project.json.

findings.claim: evidence-and-sources.mdc instructs citing pasted results as "precheck-app.txt, section 4a" and pg-upgrade-bootstrap instructs recording file path and line in Evidence, but isEvidence() in tracker-lib.mjs splits on commas and whitespace and rejects both formats when a row moves to Done or Waived.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/rules/evidence-and-sources.mdc line 13 states: "For facts about this database, cite the pasted result, by file and section, for example precheck-app.txt, section 4a", and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-bootstrap/SKILL.md line 31 states: "Evidence is the file path and line of the strongest hit." In review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/scripts/tracker-lib.mjs lines 58-64, isEvidence() splits on /[\s,;]+/ and tests each token against /^https?:\/\/\S+$/.test(t) || /[\w-]\/|[\w./-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,5}(#\S*)?$/.test(t) || /^[A-Z]{1,2}[-.]?[0-9][\w.-]*$/.test(t), which rejects the tokens "section" and "4a" as well as root-level file:line strings like "config.py:42".
findings.suggested_fix: Update evidence-and-sources.mdc to use "precheck-app.txt#section-4a" in tracker Evidence cells (matching tracker-schema.md line 24), and update isEvidence() in tracker-lib.mjs to allow ":<line>" suffixes on file paths.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-precheck part A sets B0-03 and B0-04 to In progress or Waiting on customer, but part B (parsing pasted results) never updates B0-03, B0-04, or B0-05 to Done; similarly, pg-upgrade-bootstrap and readiness-scan.md never update B0-01 or B0-02. Because B0-01 through B0-05 list G0.1 through G0.4 in their Gates column, those gates cannot pass pg-upgrade-gate-review or close in tracker-check.mjs.
findings.evidence: In review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/assets/tracker.csv lines 9-13, B0-01 and B0-02 feed G0.1, B0-03 feeds G0.2 G0.4, B0-04 feeds G0.3, and B0-05 feeds G0.2 G0.3 G0.4. review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-precheck/SKILL.md line 21 sets B0-03 and B0-04 to In progress or Waiting on customer, and lines 39-46 update Findings, Consumers, Follow-ups, G0.2, and G0.3 without ever updating B0-03, B0-04, or B0-05. Likewise, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-bootstrap/SKILL.md lines 28-46 and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/readiness-scan.md lines 28-32 never update B0-01 or B0-02.
findings.suggested_fix: Instruct pg-upgrade-bootstrap and readiness-scan.md to mark B0-01 and B0-02 Done with Evidence when searches and scans finish, and instruct pg-upgrade-precheck part B to mark B0-03, B0-04, and B0-05 Done with Evidence when their respective outputs are validated and parsed.

findings.claim: Step B.4 of pg-upgrade-precheck marks Provider outputs as pass when only the precheck JSON and operations describe output are present, omitting the instances describe YAML output. Without instances describe YAML, the agent cannot check upgradableDatabaseVersions, replicaNames, or blocking databaseFlags required by the reading guide and task B0-04.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-precheck/SKILL.md line 35 states: "Provider outputs: pass only if the precheck JSON and operations describe are present and both show the target version." By contrast, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-precheck/references/precheck-reading-guide.md line 18 requires "Precheck JSON, operations describe JSON, instances describe YAML" and lines 25-27 use instances describe to check upgradableDatabaseVersions, replicaNames, and settings.databaseFlags (citing [S-01]).
findings.suggested_fix: Require instances describe YAML in pg-upgrade-precheck/SKILL.md line 35 (including checking that upgradableDatabaseVersions lists the target version) before marking Provider outputs as pass.

findings.claim: The SOP states that if the decision record chooses the logical migration path (DMS, pglogical, or pgcopydb), the runbook skill drafts a separate logical runbook, but pg-upgrade-runbook/SKILL.md hardcodes the in-place MVU steps from Blocks 2 and 3 and never mentions section 6 of the SOP.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/sop.md line 313 states: "If the decision record picks it, the runbook skill drafts a separate logical runbook. Every Block 2 and Block 3 gate still applies, with evidence specific to this branch." However, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-runbook/SKILL.md line 8 states "The runbook template comes from Blocks 2 and 3 of <plugin>/reference/sop.md" and lines 16-34 only include in-place upgrade steps.
findings.suggested_fix: Update pg-upgrade-runbook/SKILL.md to check the chosen upgrade path in upgrade/decision-record.md and include the logical migration steps from section 6 of reference/sop.md when a logical path is selected.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-tracker states under Record an approval that only Gate and Decision rows reach Done through approval and that Task, Finding, and Consumer rows never do. This conflicts with readiness-scan.md, pg-upgrade-runbook, pg-upgrade-catch-up, and assets/tracker.csv, which place Consumer rows and review-gated Task rows (such as B0-08, B0-12, B1-05, B1-09, and B1-10) into Needs approval awaiting human confirmation or review to reach Done.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-tracker/SKILL.md line 24 states: "This applies only to Gate and Decision rows, and it's the only way they reach Done. Task, Finding and Consumer rows reach Done through evidence that shows their Done when, never through someone's approval." Yet review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/readiness-scan.md line 31 states "Set Status to Needs approval, so the repo owner can confirm it under G0.1", review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-runbook/SKILL.md line 35 states "Set B1-10 to Needs approval. The program owner and DBA review it under G1.6", and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/assets/tracker.csv lines 16, 20, 32, 36, and 37 define Task Done when conditions as owner confirmations or review approvals.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify in pg-upgrade-tracker/SKILL.md how Consumer rows and review-based Task rows in Needs approval move to Done when their owner or reviewer provides a linked confirmation or review approval.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-tracker supports "notion" as a trackerBackend and instructs agents to read rows from a Notion database via the Notion MCP server, but block-db-mcp.mjs denies any MCP tool call matching query[_-]?database regardless of server name. Because Notion MCP servers expose database queries via tools named query_database or query-database, the hook blocks Notion tracker reads.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/tracker-schema.md line 71 and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-tracker/SKILL.md lines 55-61 require reading Notion database rows through the Notion MCP server when trackerBackend is "notion". However, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/hooks/block-db-mcp.mjs lines 18 and 42 block any tool matching /(execute[_-]?sql|run[_-]?sql|run[_-]?query|query[_-]?database|\bsql\b|execute[_-]?query|psql|connect[_-]?database|instances?[_-](patch|update|delete|restart|clone|upgrade))/i on any server not listed in PG_UPGRADE_GUARD_ALLOW_MCP.
findings.suggested_fix: Scope the query[_-]?database tool-name block in hooks/block-db-mcp.mjs so it does not trigger on non-SQL project tracker MCP servers such as Notion.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-precheck and precheck-reading-guide.md direct agents to cite [S-nn] from reference/sources.md, and cite [S-37] and [S-36] (while sop.md also cites [S-34] and [S-35]), but S-34 through S-37 are missing from reference/sources.md and have no verified status or date in reference/sources.json. Additionally, S-10 has status "changed" in reference/sources.md and reference/sources.json, which requires treating claims citing it as Unverified, yet precheck-reading-guide.md line 59 cites [S-10] as a verified fact.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-precheck/references/precheck-reading-guide.md line 3 states "[S-nn] refers to this plugin's reference/sources.md", line 51 cites [S-37], line 52 cites [S-36], and line 59 states "Cloud SQL maintenance doesn't update the catalog version [S-10]." In review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/sources.md lines 47-48, the table jumps from S-33 to S-40 (omitting S-34 through S-37), and in review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/sources.json lines 620-656, S-34 through S-37 lack lastChecked, status, and verified fields; meanwhile sources.md line 24 and sources.json line 155 mark S-10 as "changed".
findings.suggested_fix: Verify S-34 through S-37 and update S-10 in reference/sources.json, then run node scripts/check-sources.mjs --write so reference/sources.md includes S-34 through S-37 and reflects current verification status.

findings.claim: catch-up-handoff-template.md contains dedicated sections for Consumers known and Findings so far, but pg-upgrade-catch-up/SKILL.md step 4 only sorts handoff items into Pasted results, Decisions, Statements from people, and Open questions. When a handoff includes known application consumers or prior findings without raw precheck files attached, the skill gives no instructions to create Consumer (C-...) or Finding (F-...) rows in the tracker.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/catch-up-handoff-template.md lines 45-53 define "## Consumers known" and "## Findings so far". In review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-catch-up/SKILL.md lines 14-19, step 4 ("Sort every fact into one of four kinds") only creates Decision and Question rows (or runs pg-upgrade-precheck on pasted results) and never mentions creating Consumer or Finding rows from the handoff.
findings.suggested_fix: Add rules in pg-upgrade-catch-up/SKILL.md step 4 for mapping the handoff's Consumers known into Consumer rows and Findings so far into Finding rows, marking unverified entries as Needs approval or Waiting on customer.

findings.claim: Gate G2.8 requires Question rows for SOP Appendix B to be closed with evidence or a named approver, and pg-upgrade-gate-review checks feeding rows for G2.8, but neither assets/tracker.csv nor pg-upgrade-bootstrap creates Question rows for the eight provider questions in SOP Appendix B. As a result, G2.8 has zero feeding Question rows in the tracker unless someone adds them manually.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/assets/tracker.csv line 50 defines G2.8 with Done when = "Question rows for SOP appendix B closed with evidence or a named approver", and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-gate-review/SKILL.md line 45 checks "G2.8: an appendix B question is still open, with no answer, demonstration or waiver." However, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/assets/tracker.csv lines 61-74 have no rows listing G2.8 in Gates, and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-bootstrap/SKILL.md lines 24-27 never create Question rows for SOP Appendix B.
findings.suggested_fix: Seed the eight SOP Appendix B questions into assets/tracker.csv (feeding G0.7 and G2.8) or instruct pg-upgrade-bootstrap step 3 to create them when initializing the tracker.

findings.claim: Both pg-upgrade-gate-review (step 5) and pg-upgrade-runbook (steps A.5 and B.6) instruct agents to modify tracker rows directly without referencing pg-upgrade-tracker or requiring Status since and Last checked updates, external trackerBackend synchronization, tracker-check.mjs validation, or dashboard re-rendering.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-gate-review/SKILL.md lines 30-33 and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-runbook/SKILL.md lines 35 and 43-46 instruct updating Gate and Task statuses in the tracker directly, omitting the rules in review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-tracker/SKILL.md lines 20-22 and 55-63 (updating Status since and Last checked, syncing to sheets/notion/linear/jira backends, running tracker-check.mjs, and running render-dashboard.mjs).
findings.suggested_fix: Instruct pg-upgrade-gate-review step 5 and pg-upgrade-runbook steps A.5 and B.6 to apply all tracker updates through pg-upgrade-tracker (including timestamps, external backend sync, tracker-check.mjs, and dashboard rendering).

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-tracker, pg-upgrade-precheck, pg-upgrade-bootstrap, and tracker-schema.md state that a row with Owner = unknown gets a matching Question row, but none specify that the Question row must list the target row's ID in its Depends on column. Because tracker-lib.mjs checks Question rows' Depends on column to verify this rule, tracker-check.mjs emits warnings even when agents create the Question rows as instructed.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-tracker/SKILL.md line 19 states "Owner is a name or unknown. An unknown owner gets a question row", and review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/tracker-schema.md line 58 states "An unknown owner always has a question row." In review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/scripts/tracker-lib.mjs lines 83 and 112-114, validate() builds questionsFor from Question rows' Depends on column and warns "Owner is unknown and no Question row depends on this row".
findings.suggested_fix: Specify in pg-upgrade-tracker/SKILL.md and reference/tracker-schema.md that a Question row created for an unknown Owner must include the target row's ID in its Depends on column.

findings.claim: When syncing upgrade/tracker-pending.csv to an external backend, pg-upgrade-tracker step 1 requires detecting whether the backend's row changed since the pending row was written, while step 4 overwrites upgrade/tracker.csv with the new change and appends to tracker-pending.csv. Because neither file preserves the pre-edit remote row state or a sub-day timestamp, conflicts cannot be detected deterministically and multiple offline edits create duplicate IDs in tracker-pending.csv.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-tracker/SKILL.md line 57 states "If the backend's row changed since the pending row was written, report the conflict instead of overwriting either one", and line 61 states "Apply it to upgrade/tracker.csv, append the changed row to upgrade/tracker-pending.csv".
findings.suggested_fix: Record the last-synced remote row snapshot (or version/hash) before applying offline edits, and update any existing row with the same ID in upgrade/tracker-pending.csv rather than appending duplicates.

findings.claim: Part 4 of precheck-reading-guide.md defines section 2 (Blockers) of the findings report as only provider ERROR entries and nonempty 6a-6d rows while placing all of sections 3, 5b, and 6e under section 3 (Prework), contradicting part 3 where items in 3, 5b, and 6e are explicitly marked as upgrade blockers; part 3 also omits the pg_squeeze 1.8 floor from [S-01].
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-precheck/references/precheck-reading-guide.md line 40 states "pg_ivm blocks [S-01]. PostGIS below 3.6.0 on Cloud SQL 18 [S-01]. adminpack is gone in 17 [S-18]", line 45 states "Both are blockers (G0.4)", and line 50 states "A blocking flag needs removing first [S-01]", whereas lines 66-67 state "2. Blockers. Each provider ERROR and each nonempty 6a to 6d row... 3. Prework. Rows from 3, 5b, 6e to 6g, 7 and 8". In addition, review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/sources.json S-01 line 28 quotes "upgrade the pg_squeeze extension for all of your databases to version 1.6, 1.7, or 1.8 respectively", which appears in sop.md line 83 but is missing from precheck-reading-guide.md line 40.
findings.suggested_fix: Include blocking rows from kit sections 3, 5b, and 6e under Blockers in part 4 line 66 of precheck-reading-guide.md, and add the pg_squeeze floor ([S-01]) to section 3 in part 3.

findings.claim: pg-upgrade-precheck step A.1 interpolates --target-database-version=POSTGRES_<target> from project.json, but project.schema.json allows target to be "undecided" or "unknown" during Block 0 when pg-upgrade-bootstrap invokes pg-upgrade-precheck.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/reference/project.schema.json line 13 defines target as "Target major version, \"undecided\", or \"unknown\"", while review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-precheck/SKILL.md line 18 writes "gcloud sql instances pre-check-major-version-upgrade <instance> --target-database-version=POSTGRES_<target> --format=json" without handling "undecided" or "unknown".
findings.suggested_fix: Instruct pg-upgrade-precheck step A.1 to check whether target in project.json is "undecided" or "unknown" and, if so, use an explicit candidate target version (such as POSTGRES_18) or a placeholder accompanied by a question row.

findings.claim: Step 3 of pg-upgrade-bootstrap tells the agent to fill answers for seed questions Q-01 to Q-14 if given in the bootstrap inputs, but does not specify which CSV columns or Status to update, and tracker-check.mjs rejects free-text answers in Evidence or Status = Done without a valid Evidence token.
findings.evidence: review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/skills/pg-upgrade-bootstrap/SKILL.md line 26 states: "The seed already has standard questions Q-01 to Q-14. Fill their answers if the inputs give them." In review/plugins/pg-major-upgrade/scripts/tracker-lib.mjs lines 4-9 and 91-94, there is no Answer column, Done requires Evidence, and isEvidence() rejects free text.
findings.suggested_fix: Specify in pg-upgrade-bootstrap/SKILL.md line 26 that answers from the bootstrap prompt go into Notes, with Evidence set to upgrade/project.json and Status set to Needs approval (or Done when project.json satisfies Done when).
